id_schemes_warning: Two different numberings exist. Atlas/opening-territories id (S01-S16) is authoritative canon id. generate-catalog.mjs slug sNN is Sixteen-States.md table row order and is NOT the atlas id (e.g. 급수계약정: id S01, slug s10).

mismatches.location: LORE/offices/Offices-and-Ranks.md:51 (### 원불교 heading in 국가별 관직)
mismatches.explanation: 원불교 is the origin institution of 교헌필사정 in Sixteen-States.md (기원 column), not the state name. The 국가별 관직표 row (line 89) already uses 교헌필사정. The other 12 prose headings use the state name.
mismatches.classification: stale label repair (no content change); tiers and prose body are unchanged and already match atlas offices
mismatches.consumer_impact: none today: generate-catalog.mjs reads only the 관직표 table, never prose headings. A JSON conversion keyed on headings would break.

non_mismatch_notes: Three prose headings merge two states with ' · ' (급수계약정·선로후계정, 호위보호정·관문군정, 서초전산그룹·양재기공주식회사); 13 headings cover 16 states. Each merged pair shares one identical tier row, so JSON must store per-state rows and treat the merged heading as presentation.
Heading 대한민국정부/설교명부정/etc. match canonical names exactly.

consumer.office_table_regex: /\| 국가 \| 티어1 \|[\s\S]*?(?=\n## )/  -- starts at the 관직표 header, ends before next '## ' heading
consumer.row_regex: /^\| ([^|]+) \| ([^|]+) \| ([^|]+) \| ([^|]+) \| ([^|]+) \| ([^|]+) \|$/gm -- exactly 6 cells, no leading/trailing spaces beyond one
assumptions: Table header literal '| 국가 | 티어1 |' must exist and the table must be followed by a '## ' heading.
Key is state display name from person.state_name (cast data); must equal the 국가 cell text (교헌필사정, not 원불교).
Tier index = position of person's 품계 string in the 5 cells; T1..T5 = index+1; unmatched rank throws E_PERSON_TIER_MISSING (S00 exempt, forced T5).
Separator row '|---|...' has 6 cells of dashes and does not match the row regex only by accident of the [^|]+ cells; it is harmless because lookup is by name.
Prose headings, the 다섯 층 table and the 옛 조선 관직 치환 table are not consumed.
consumer.state_slug_assumption: stateSlug = 's' + (row index in Sixteen-States.md 국명 table + 1); this is table order, different from atlas ids. Confirmed by opening-territories.json (S01 급수계약정 slug s10, S08 교헌필사정 slug s08, S06 대한민국정부 slug s01).
consumer.ruler_map: hard-coded rulerByState keyed by state name; 교헌필사정 -> 오해린

other_inline_features: Text contains a literal ' — ' (em dash) in the 다섯 층 table cell for tier 2 (line 17), ' · ' (middle dot) in headings and prose, and '—' as separator in tier chains (e.g. 대통령—장관—차관—국장—주사) inside the 13 국가별 paragraphs. Renderer must keep these characters verbatim.
Table cells contain no pipes, no links, no emphasis.

recommendation.pilot_suitability: Good pilot: 16x5 table is already machine-equal to atlas offices[]; only lossy part is 25 prose paragraphs plus 3 tables and 2 links, all plain text.
recommendation.json_shape: Store canonical rows keyed by atlas state id S01-S16 with name + tiers[5]; keep prose sections as ordered blocks (heading, paragraph, table, link spans). Do not key by prose heading or by generate-catalog slug.
recommendation.repair: Rename '### 원불교' to '### 교헌필사정' (stale label repair, ~1 line, no content/tier change). Do not apply here; canon edits are out of scope.
